title: When the Aftermath Breaks
author: Orsen Sandoval
blurb: Gideon Halloran, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the house sale closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
